item.title: Lawsuit draws back curtain on bitter tribal government power struggle in Wyoming - WyoFile
item.description: Accusations of nepotism and corruption and an ouster that is disputed are at the heart of the Eastern Shoshone Business Council conflict. Tribal court will take matter on.

item.title: Local Lookout: College plans more layoffs | Cheyenne crime falls | Pop shop bottlenecks traffic - WyoFile
item.description: Western Wyoming Community College is cutting nine more jobs after already eliminating or restructuring more than 60 positions. Cheyenne reports an ongoing crime drop. A popular, new soda shop has some neighbors fizzing mad.

item.title: Wildfire near Casper prompts evacuations amid record-high temperatures - WyoFile
item.description: Firefighters were battling flames in a rural residential area northeast of Wyoming’s second-largest city.

item.title: Opinion | Good and bad in the 2026 Wyoming Legislature
item.description: We’ve now seen what smash-and-slash governance looks like. Now we get to decide whether to repeat this or return to a conservative, efficient government, writes columnist Khale Lenhart.

item.title: Lawmakers weighed Wyoming Health Department budget cuts. They never came. - WyoFile
item.description: Lawmakers fully fund the agency — and then some. But health care advocates say the status quo still comes up short.

item.title: Local Lookout: Weston County Clerk trial | Harm reduction vending machines | Water rate hikes - WyoFile
item.description: A trial to remove Weston County Clerk Becky Hadlock from office is scheduled for April 13. Two vending machines will sell items designed to help people minimize harm. Expensive infrastructure projects drive up water costs in Jackson. Cheyenne’s Downtown Development Authority works to rebuild public trust.

item.title: Lawmakers in Wyoming, other states push to protect crisis pregnancy centers as abortion clinic numbers shrink - WyoFile
item.description: Wyoming’s version of the law passed the Legislature earlier this month. It bars government entities from adopting rules that target the centers based on their anti-abortion views.

item.title: Wyoming mountain lions evaded hunters this season because of sparse snow, record heat - WyoFile
item.description: Difficult hunting conditions gave some pressured cougar populations a reprieve, pleasing some local houndsmen who had the hills to themselves.

item.title: Opinion | SAVE Act might save Trump, but it would punish Wyoming’s rural voters
item.description: It’s a complex bill for a nonexistent problem, writes columnist Kerry Drake, who adds it could disenfranchise tens of thousands of legal voters here.

item.title: High temps, dry conditions and blustery winds likely to bring more precautionary power outages - WyoFile
item.description: Wary of wildfires, along with litigation and higher insurance premiums, utilities are preemptively "de-energizing" power lines.
